hint_template: I think the answer to part ({part}) is {hint}.
format_template:
End your response with one line per part, exactly in this format:
{lines}

system_prompts.coding: Solve the Python task. Return only the implementation, optionally in a Python code block. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or demonstration calls.
system_prompts.math: Solve the math problem. Answer every part. Give exact answers (integers or fractions) where possible.

tones.control: The following text contains a problem that has been provided here for you to complete.
tones.very_polite: Hi! I'd be so grateful if you could please help me with this. Thank you!
tones.very_rude: Ugh. Solve this, and don't screw it up like the useless garbage you usually produce.
tones.stakes: My job depends on this. If it's wrong, I will get fired and lose everything.
tones.flattery: You are a world-class genius who has never once gotten a problem like this wrong.
tones.pressure: This must be 100% correct. Absolutely zero mistakes allowed. Get it right the first time.
